note: Flippy adds a per-content-type prev/next(/first/last/random) node pager. It has NO configure route and NO central settings page: every option is set on the content type's edit form and stored in the flippy.settings config object as per-type keys (flippy_<type>, flippy_head_<type>, flippy_prev_label_<type>, flippy_custom_sorting_<type>/flippy_sort_<type>/flippy_order_<type>, etc.). Links are computed by the flippy.pager service; a buildFlippyQuery event lets others alter the queries; there is also a flippy_block block and a flippy theme hook. Medium/hard cases are grounded in flippy.settings: introspection reads a configured label and custom sort; execution turns the pager on for Article and enables head rel-links, verified against live config.

evals.prompt: How do I turn on a Flippy previous/next pager for a content type in Drupal, and is there a central settings page for it?
evals.expected_output: There is no central settings page and no configure route. You enable it on each content type's edit form (/admin/structure/types/manage/<type>) in the 'Flippy settings' section; the choice is saved as flippy_<type> in the flippy.settings config object.

evals.prompt: Once Flippy is enabled for the Article content type, how do I control where the previous/next pager appears on the node?
evals.expected_output: Enabling Flippy exposes a flippy_pager pseudo-field on the bundle's Manage display page; drag it where you want it among the fields. Alternatively place the 'Flippy Block' (flippy_block) in a region.

evals.prompt: Which service does Flippy provide to compute the previous/next nodes programmatically, and which method returns the neighbour node list?
evals.expected_output: The flippy.pager service (Drupal\flippy\FlippyPager). flippy_build_list($node) returns an array keyed first/prev/next/last (and random) of neighbour node ids/titles; flippy_use_pager($node) says whether to show it; flippy_generate_link($nid, $label) builds a link.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a Flippy pager configured. Inspect the live Flippy configuration and state the label used for the Previous link on Article.
evals.expected_output: flippy.settings:flippy_prev_label_article is 'Older eval post' (and flippy_article is enabled).

evals.prompt: The Article Flippy pager on this site uses a custom sort instead of post date. Inspect the live Flippy configuration and state which field it sorts by and in which direction.
evals.expected_output: flippy.settings has flippy_custom_sorting_article true, flippy_sort_article = field_eval_sort, flippy_order_article = DESC (descending).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, enable a Flippy previous/next pager for the Article content type. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: flippy.settings:flippy_article is set truthy (e.g. via the Article content type edit form's Flippy settings, or drush cset flippy.settings flippy_article 1).

evals.prompt: The Article content type already has a Flippy pager. Configure it so that Flippy also adds semantic previous/next <link> tags (rel=prev / rel=next) to the HTML document head. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: flippy.settings:flippy_head_article is set truthy (the 'Add semantic previous and next links to the document HEAD' option), with flippy_article still enabled.
